title: Speed Dribble Four-Touch Race
description: Players race to cover half the court in as few dribbles as possible, learning to push the ball out ahead and run onto it.

content.objective: Use a long push dribble in the open floor, covering ground with four dribbles or fewer from baseline to half court.
content.setup: Two lines on the baseline, one ball per player.
content.organization: Players race the player in the other line.
instructions: On the whistle, push the ball out ahead at waist height and sprint after it.
Count the dribbles to the half-court line; target four or fewer.
Continue to the far rim and finish with a lay-up.
Return along the sideline to the other line.
Repeat with the other hand from the other line.
coachingPoints: Push the ball forward, not down.
Let the ball travel a full stride ahead.
Run upright and fast; collect the ball low near the rim.
commonMistakes: Bouncing the ball straight down and over-dribbling.
Pushing too far and losing the ball to the sideline.
content.safety: Racers stay in their own half of the lane; the next pair waits until the finish is clear.
progressions: Add a chasing defender who starts on the free-throw line.
regressions: Finish with a jump stop instead of a lay-up.
variations: Finish with a pass to a trailing teammate.
successCriteria: Reaches half court in four dribbles or fewer with control.
Makes the lay-up at full speed.
content.gameApplication: In transition the ball must move faster than the defense; fewer, longer dribbles get there first.
